Pleasant dinner 🥰
Sep 2026 • Family
We had a really great dinner: excellent dishes, pleasant atmosphere, and impeccable service. A special thanks to Huong who was very kind, smiling, and very attentive throughout the evening. We ordered Italian dishes but wanted to try a specialty from Hue, and she was very sweet and even explained how to eat it, the Nem Lụi, which is also a must-try, exquisite! 
It made our dinner even more pleasant. 😊
Absolutely recommended!
